units.source_text: 岛村无所事事，要唤回对自然和自己容易失去的真挚感情，最好是爬山。

en.t: For Shimamura, idle as he was, the best way to call back the sincere feelings he so easily lost toward nature and himself was to climb mountains.

units.source_text: 于是他常常独自去爬山。

en.t: So he often went mountain climbing alone.

units.source_text: 他在县界区的山里呆了七天，那天晚上一到温泉浴场，就让人去给他叫艺妓。

en.t: After spending seven days in the mountains along the prefectural border, he arrived at the hot spring resort that evening and immediately asked someone to call a geisha for him.

units.source_text: 但是女佣回话说：那天刚好庆祝新铁路落成，

en.t: But the maid replied that the day happened to be a celebration for the completion of the new railway line,

units.source_text: 村里的茧房和戏棚也都用作了宴会场地，异常热闹，

en.t: and even the village cocoon storehouse and theater shed had been turned into banquet halls, making the place extraordinarily lively,

units.source_text: 十二三个艺妓人手已经不够，怎么可能叫来呢？

en.t: with only twelve or thirteen geisha already too few for the work, how could one possibly be called away?

units.source_text: 不过，老师傅家的姑娘即便去宴会上帮忙，顶多表演两三个节目就可以回来，

en.t: However, the girl from the teacher's house, even if she was helping at the banquet, could probably come back after performing two or three numbers at most,
so perhaps she might answer the summons and come.
When Shimamura asked again in more detail,

units.source_text: 女佣作了这样简短的说明：三弦琴、舞蹈师傅家里的那位姑娘虽不是艺妓，

en.t: the maid gave this brief explanation: the girl in the house of the shamisen and dance teacher was not a geisha,

units.source_text: 可有时也应召参加一些大型宴会什么的。

en.t: but at times she was called to help at large banquets and the like.

units.source_text: 这里没有年轻的，中年的倒很多，却不愿跳舞。

en.t: There were no young ones here; there were plenty of middle-aged women, but they did not want to dance.

units.source_text: 这么一来，姑娘就更显得可贵了。

en.t: That made the girl seem all the more valuable.

units.source_text: 虽然她不常一个人去客栈旅客的房间，但也不能说是个无瑕的良家闺秀了。

en.t: Although she did not often go alone to a guest's room at an inn, she could no longer be called an entirely innocent young lady of a good family.
